coverage.why: analysis_accounting.json drops the cost_deferral and cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sheet findings at the gate, and analysis_financial.json drops the profitability reading, so those count as unanswered.

calibration.why: Each surviving verdict matches its anomalies: earnings_versus_cash names the payables gap and bonus timing, revenue_recognition the untestable receivable days and concentration, estimates_and_reserves the valuation-allowance release and flat credit-loss cover. The dropped areas have no verdict to test.

valuation_reading.why: calculator.json has no market, valuation or implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth, so the reading states no price position and no implied growth. Its most_sensitive assumptions are chosen by judgment because no valuation.sensitivity exists.
